information.description:
True believers who preach the gang's creed and police its members, usually with a partner. Not front-liners, but heavily chromed and experienced.

Maelstrom: Chrome-mad gangers who carve out their own eyes to join.

Stat block from Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis, unofficial content under R. Talsorian Games' Homebrew Content Policy. Portrait: Neon Hub fan art of the Cyberpunk 2077 setting (CD PROJEKT RED), free to use, not for sale.

Threat: Elite Hardened Lieutenant • Reputation: 2 • Facedown #: 6 • COM#: 12 • Role: Enforcer: Officer 4 (Authority 3 ⦁ Backup 1)

Enforcer: Has x1 Bodyguard Team Member (CP:R, pg. 154) from the Backup Veteran Ability. When interacting with other Maelstrom members that they have some level of seniority over, Zealots gain a +3 bonus to Acting, Bribery, Conversation, Interrogation, and Persuasion Skill Checks against them thanks to the Authority Veteran Ability.

With gear or role bonuses: Interrogation 8 (11), Perception 8 (10), Persuasion 8 (11)

Melee SP (head/body): 4/4
